lead.en: Replay host-supplied draft and verification rounds.
lead.zh: 回放宿主提供的草稿和验证轮次。

rule.en: The host supplies the rounds; recorded and illustrative runs are explicitly labelled. Leading token spaces are preserved, acceptance is bounded, and speedup is an estimate based on configured draft cost.
rule.zh: 轮次由宿主提供，记录与示意数据明确区分；保留 token 前导空格、限制接受数量，并按配置的草稿成本估算加速比。

api.en: Play, pause, restart or enable the illustrative target-only comparison; set_visible stops off-screen playback. The host controls loading, failure and retry.
api.zh: 支持播放、暂停、重新开始及示意性的单目标模型对照；set_visible 停止屏外播放。加载、失败和重试由宿主管理。

motion.en: Drafts fade and slide in, verification sweeps across each chip, and accepted tokens appear in sequence; reduced motion steps directly. Full cross-position token flight and rolling statistics remain different from the reference; visual, touch and accessibility validation remain pending.
motion.zh: 草稿依次淡入滑入，验证逐项扫过，接受的 token 错峰显示；减少动效时直接切换。跨位置飞行和滚动统计仍与参考站不同；视觉、触屏和无障碍验收仍待完成。
